sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:6763
Court No. - 76

Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 9345 of 2023
Applicant :- Dilshad Husain

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Madan Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Dharm Jeet Singh
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Sri Rajiv Dhar Dwivedi, learned Aga apprised the Court that he has received the instructions,
therefore, the instant anticipatory bail application may be finally, disposed off.

2. Heard Sri Madan Singh, learned counsel for the applicant; Sri Dharm Jeet Singh, learned counsel for informant and Sri Rajiv Dhar Dwivedi, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent.
3.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No. 201 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 354 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act and Section 3/4 Muslim Women (Protection of Right on Marriage Act), Police Station Pakwada, District Moradabad, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail, till the conclusion of trial.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is jeth of the informant and on the basis of false allegations, applicant has been made accused in the present matter.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submitted that it is a case of matrimonial dispute and for all the offences maximum punishment is of seven years and after service of notice under section 41-A Cr.P.C. charge sheet has been filed against the applicant without his arrest.
6. He further submitted that applicant is having apprehension that if he will appear before the court concerned then he will be sent to jail.
7. He further submitted that applicant is having previous criminal history of one case but it was of sections 504 and 506 IPC and the same has been explained in the anticipatory bail application.

8. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail but could not dispute the fact that applicant is the jeth of the informant and during investigation he was not arrested.
9. I have heard learned counsel for both the sides and perused the record of the case.

10. Considering the facts that applicant is the jeth of the informant and during investigation without his arrest charge sheet has been filed and all the offences are punishable with maximum punishment of seven years, in my view, applicant is entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in this case, till conclusion of trial.

11. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion upon ultimate merits of the case either ways which may adversely affect the trial of the case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.

entities.text: Dilshad Husain vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.

14. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
